    MagnitudeConjecture.RightModule.FiniteIndecomposableSkeleton.standardFormUniversalIndecMeshFunctor_isCovering

    Riedtmann covering theorem for the normalized universal realization #

    This file implements the radical-layer argument of Riedtmann, Proposition 2.3, for the normalized standard-form universal mesh functor. The right almost-split half first approximates every fixed-target morphism by lifted mesh paths modulo successive powers of the categorical radical.
